experiment: Adversarial validation of the Q-081 DSR restatement
design: Recomputed the published headline on the non-overlapping sample, then discounted for cross-sectional clustering (Kish design effect) and differenced each trade against an equal-weight hold of the same universe over the same window.
selection_metric: none — this run selected nothing; it re-measured an existing published claim
notes: quant-validator REJECTED the claim of skill. De-overlapping alone left the sample ~2.6x too large: 56 correlated names trading the same window means trades sharing a calendar block are one bet placed many times. The excess over an equal-weight hold of the SAME universe (survivorship cancels in the difference) is not statistically distinguishable from zero. Logged per the standing order to record every experiment including failures — and note that logging it no longer threatens CI, because the gate was re-based onto the Sharpe after the DSR floor was found to punish compliance.
